display.family: Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

body.family: Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

rules.name: One navy signal system
rules.body: Use navy tonal changes and opacity for emphasis. Do not introduce a second brand accent.

rules.name: Instrument over decoration
rules.body: Axis lines, ticks, readouts, and active course states must explain the real course sequence. Do not add fake charts or looping analytics.

rules.name: Sharp research geometry
rules.body: Keep one near-sharp corner language and let rules, alignment, and whitespace provide hierarchy.

rules.name: Motion with purpose
rules.body: Use motion for explanation, state indication, spatial consistency, and tactile feedback. Gate hover and honor reduced motion.

rules.name: Source truth
rules.body: Use the main notice for dates, prices, format, address, payment, and deadline; use each course notice for its own audience and syllabus; preserve missing QR and registration URL.
